Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The players are out in the middle. Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Hazratullah Zazai are the openers for Afghanistan. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to bowl now.
...THE CHASE...
Right then! A huge score and Afghanistan need to show some class to chase this down. Stay tuned as the chase is coming up.

Here is the man of the hour, Virat Kohli up for a quick chat. He says he is blessed and grateful for last 2 and a half years and that has thought him alot. This was the least he was expecting to score a 100 in T20. It was a great time after having a break and the team welcomed him very well and they supported him. Says after the century he kissed his ring to thank his wife as she had my back through my rough patch and this is also dedicated to her daughter, Vamika. Tells he was very happy to comeback after having a stressful time mentally and physically. Ends by saying he is very happy to score this century.

India will be delighted with the score. It was the opening partnership that helped India score this huge score. Both, KL Rahul and Virat Kohli started brightly and scored their respective fifty. Rahul fell but there was no stopping from the other end. Virat Kohli was just playing without any pressure and was scoring boundaries for free. Kohli's 122 included 12 fours and 6 huge sixes. A sparking hundred from King Kohli!

Afghanistan won the toss but after that, it was all India. They looked a bit dizzy, playing back-to-back games and it was clearly seen in their fielding as they dropped few catches. The seamers got some swing early on but they failed to create pressure. Rashid Khan and Mohammad Nabi were erring in their lines. It was really poor performance with the ball by Afghanistan.

The curse is broken! It took 1,019 days for Virat Kohli to score his much-awaited 71st century. That took a while but it was worth waiting. The King has also finally hit his maiden T20I century. So many records have been broken but Virat Kohli has finally done it. Indian cricket fans can finally say - the King is back with a bang.
A bumper on middle. Kohli skips down to pull but misses. A dot to end but the damage is convincingly done by Kohli. India finish with 212/2.
Full and on off, eased down to long on for one. Can Virat Kohli finish on a high?
Fuller length, onto the pads. Virat Kohli flicks it towards the square leg for a single.
FOUR! 6, 6, 4! Virat Kohli is on fire! This is some shot though! Too full and on middle. Kohli makes room and drives it through covers for a boundary.
SIX! TWO IN A ROW! This is a slower bouncer, around off. Kohli anticipates it well as he stays back and powers it over mid-wicket for a biggie. What a knock this is!
SIX! Kohli, the finisher now! On a length and on middle. Kohli skips down and hits it through the line over long off for a biggie.

FOUR! India nearing the 200 mark! A slower bouncer on middle. Pant looks to pull but gets a top edge to deep square leg where Mujeeb Ur Rahman runs in but drops his second catch. It rolls away to the fence.
On middle, eased down to long on for a single.
This is full and outside off. Kohli drives it crisply through covers for a brace.
Around off, driven through covers for one. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. The back up makes a fumble and allows another run. Two runs.

SIX! CENTURY FOR KING KOHLI! 71ST IS HERE! It came after quite a while but here is his hundred! What a knock by the legend! Absolutely sensation! The crowd erupts at Dubai! Short in length and outside off. Kohli pulls it all the way over mid-wicket for a biggie. There is a big smile on his face as he hits the six. He stretches his arms and takes all the applause. A treat to watch the master at work.
FOUR! Virat Kohli moves to 94! Straight down the ground. This is full and outside off. Kohli smacks it straight for four.
Slower delivery, outside off. Virat Kohli pushes it towards long off and he will keep the strike.

FOUR! Kohli is playing from the start but there is no drop in energy by the King! A bit of luck here! This is short and around off. Kohli looks to cut it away but gets an outside edge over backward point for a boundary,
Slower delivery, short of a length. Virat Kohli pulls it into the gap towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Farooqi tries the yorker but serves it outside off. Kohli opens the face of the bat and guides it through point for four more. Virat Kohli is 17 runs away from his hundred.
Slower delivery, short of a length. Virat Kohli pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
A yorker, outside off. Pant squeezes it to long on for one.
Wide! A length ball, way outside off. Pant leaves it alone.
FOUR! 15 runs off the over! Virat Kohli is on 77 now! This is just great from King Kohli! On a length and on middle. Kohli steps down and across to flick it to deep square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Well played! This is very full and just outside off. Kohli steps across and whips it past the square leg fielder for a boundary.
Outside off, worked to long off for a single.

FOUR! DROPPED! This is short and around off. Pant was hurried as he looks to pull. The ball goes high and behind square on the leg side where Mujeeb Ur Rahman tries to take over his head but didn't look stable at all. He parries it away for four.
A widish yorker, outside off. Kohli jams it out to long off for a single. He wanted a single but the fielder was quick.
Length and on top of off. Pant works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Kohli skips down and nudges it to mid-wicket for a brace. Virat Kohli is looking in very good touch!
SIX! BANG! This is full and around middle and leg. Kohli uses his feet yet again and launches it over long on for a six.
Shorter and outside off, cut hard to deep cover for a single.
This is full and outside off. Kohli comes down the track and drives it to long off for a single.
Flatter and on off. Pant cuts it to point for a single.
Around off. Pant keeps it out.
Fuller length, onto the leg stump. Rishabh Pant strides forward and gets a leading edge which lands to the left of the bowler for a single.
Fuller length, onto the middle and leg stump. Virat Kohli sweeps it down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
'Round the wicket. Fuller length, around middle. Rishabh Pant flicks it down to the fielder at deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter and angling on middle. Kohli tries to whack it over but mistimes it to the mid-wicket region for a single.
Fuller length, outside of. Virat Kohli drives of the front foot and the short extra cover does well to stop that one.
Fuller length, on off. Virat Kohli comes down the pitch and pushes it back to the bowler.
Beauty of a delivery! Pitched up, full and outside off, probably another googly. Pant looks to cut but misses. Khan appeals but noting doing.
Flighted delivery, slower through the air, outside off. Rishabh Pant tries to go big with the slog sweep but misses it completely.
Fuller length, onto the stumps. Rishabh Pant defends it onto the pitch.
FOUR! Pant is off the mark! Flatter and on middle. Pant gets low and sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Short of length, onto the middle and leg. Rishabh Pant defends it towards the fielder at short extra cover.
Short of length, onto the pads. Virat Kohli pushes it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Rishabh Pant walks in.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Six and out on the next delivery for Suryakumar Yadav! On a length and nipping in from around the wicket. Yadav tries to play it towards third man but the angle makes it hard. He gets an inside edge back onto the stumps.
SIX! WOW! Suryakumar Yadav is just brilliant! Tad short and down leg. Yadav gets low and just helps it away over fine leg for a biggie. Doesn't even bother to look back.
Suryakumar Yadav is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Rahul perishes and that is the end of a very fine innings from the stand-in captain! On a length and around off, a cross-seam delivery. Rahul clears his front leg and looks to whack it over long on but mistimes and Najibullah Zadran takes a simple catch. The 119-run opening stand is broken.
Commentary.Howout: c Najibullah Zadran b Fareed Ahmad

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! These two are certainly looking for a triple-digit score! What a great shot this is! Short of a length and on leg. Rahul goes across and pulls it behind the keeper to fine leg for a biggie.
Back of a length, on off stump. Virat Kohli dances down the track and pushes it towards mid-off fielder for a quick single.
Back of a length, around off. KL Rahul punches it towards deep point for a quick single.
FOUR! Third boundary of the over! 16 runs off the over! This is touch short and Kohli doesn't need a second invitation. He pulls it to deep mid-wicket for four.
Fuller length, outside off. KL Rahul cuts it down to the fielder at deep cover for a single.
Fuller length, onto the pads. KL Rahul plays it with soft hands towards the vacant area at mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
FIFTY FOR RAHUL! Nice to way to get the half-century! He too will be happy to get some runs under his belt! Nabi follows Rahul on the leg side. This is lofted over covers for four.
FOUR! Well played! The spinners have been erring in their lines! This is short and around off. Rahul pulls it off the back foot over mid-wicket for four. 100 up!
A single! Full and on middle. Kohli skips down and nudges it to mid-wicket. The man there runs to his left but misfields and parries it away. A single.

FIFTY FOR VIRAT KOHLI! The good thing for India is Virat Kohli has found his form in Asia Cup! Another fifty for him! This is on a length and outside off. Kohli pushes it to long off for a single. These two need to hit more boundaries now, knowing there are 10 wickets in the bag.
Short of length, outside off. Virat Kohli reaches to the ball and cuts it towards short extra cover.
Fuller length, around off. KL Rahul flicks it off the inside half of the bat towards the square leg region for a single.
Slower delivery, onto the middle and leg. Virat Kohli pushes it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! IN THE GAP! Short of a length and outside off. Kohli pulls it in the gap to deep square leg and the ball finds the fence.
Short, outside off. KL Rahul tries to cut it but gets an outside edge and the ball goes towards third man region for a single.

Drinks! An excellent start for India and they are well on course for a score around 200. A nice platform is set for the upcoming batters to play their game. Afghanistan are finding it hard to break this stand. They need to build some pressure.
Fuller length, outside off. KL Rahul drives it towards long off for a single.
On middle, this is flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up, outside of. KL Rahul uses his feet and pushes it towards cover for a single.
Short of length, onto the middle and leg. Virat Kohli flicks it towards the square leg for a single.
Quicker and shorter, onto the pads. KL Rahul pushes it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Edged and it falls safe! Flatter ball, around off. Rahul gets on his knee as he looks to sweep but gets a top edge behind the keeper and wide of short third man for a couple of runs.
A single as this is hit to deep mid-wicket by Rahul.
Fuller length, around off stump. Virat Kohli goes down on one knee and slog sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Yet another beautiful shot from the blade of Kohli! A loopy ball, full and outside off. Kohli skips down and goes inside-out over covers and the ball reaches to the fence.
Fuller length, on off. Virat Kohli defends it towards mid off.
Short of length, Onto the middle. KL Rahul knocks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller length, onto the off. Virat Kohli pushes it towards the short cover fielder for a quick single.
Short of length, outside off. Virat Kohli goes on the backfoot and dabs it towards the gully region for a quick single.
Quicker delivery, on off. KL Rahul makes room and drives it towards mid off for a single.
Fuller length, on off. Virat Kohli pushes it towards long off for a single.

SIX! Anything short and these two are taking it over! A chance though! This is short and around off. Kohli pulls it flat and to deep mid-wicket. Ibrahim Zadran there was standing a few inches ahead of the ropes. He mistimes his jump and lets the ball through his right hand and over the ropes for a biggie. It will count as a chance..
Short, on off. KL Rahul goes back and punches it towards long on for a single.
Fuller length, on the pads. Virat Kohli tucks it towards short fine leg for a single.
Change. Mohammad Nabi to bowl now.
Short of length, outside off. Virat Kohli pushes it towards long on for a single.
Fuller length, turning in. KL Rahul knocks it towards long on for a single.
SIX! THAT IS HUGE! Touch short from Khan, around off and Rahul is quick to get on the back foot. He pulls it all the way over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Fuller length, onto the stumps. KL Rahul defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller length, outside off. KL Rahul pushes it towards mid off.
Short, wide outside off. Virat Kohli knocks it towards deep cover for a single.
Change. Rashid Khan is into the attack.
On middle, tucked to mid-wicket for one. 15 runs off the over. Excellent from India. At the end of the Powerplay, India are 52/0.
SIX! WHAT A SHOT! Tossed up, around off, in the slot. Kohli again comes down the track and lofts it nonchalantly over long off for a biggie. 50 up!
FOUR! These two are dealing in boundaries at the moment! You rarely see Kohli playing the sweep! Fuller ball, angling on middle, it is swept past square leg for a boundary.
Short and spinning into off stump. Virat Kohli goes back and punches it but the fielder at extra covers does well to stop this one.
FOUR! Beats the fielder! This is full and outside off. Kohli skips down and smashes it past mid off for a boundary.
Fuller length, angling in. Virat Kohli plays it towards short mid wicket.
FOUR! KL Rahul is looking in fine form! Much needed for him! This is too easy for Rahu! Short and on middle, it is pulled to deep square leg for a boundary.
Slower delivery, on a good length, on off stump. KL Rahul punches it back to the bowler.
On a good length, on off stump line. KL Rahul tucks it to short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Class from Rahul! Length and outside off, bit of width and Rahul cuts it through point for four.

Short of a length, onto the leg stump line. KL Rahul tries to pull that one but misses it and the ball hits his thigh pad, there is an appeal for LBW by Fareed Ahmad but the umpire doesn't seem interested. It was pitching outside leg.
On a good length, outside off. Virat Kohli pushes it towards mid off for a quick single.
FOUR! Good shot! Mujeeb Ur Rahman drops a bit short and Rahul makes the most of it. This is around leg, it is pulled away past square leg for four.
Fuller length, on off stump. KL Rahul drives it down to the covers for no run.
Short of length, onto the middle stump. KL Rahul comes down the pitch and plays it towards mid off for no run.
This one stays a bit low on middle. Kohli works it to mid-wicket for one.
Flatter and on middle. Rahul makes room and punches it through covers for a single.
Fuller length, on the middle stump line. Virat Kohli knocks it down to dep mid wicket for a single.
On a good length, outside off. KL Rahul lofts it over the mid off region for a couple of runs.
Edged but no slip. Fazalhaq Farooqi bowls a bit fuller, outside off. Virat Kohli goes for the drive and gets an outside edge and the ball races away towards the third man region for a single.
FOUR! First boundary now for Kohli! This is full and on middle. Kohli whips it behind square leg for another boundary.
Fuller length, angling in. KL Rahul pushes it towards mid off for a quick single.
FOUR! First boundary of the game! Beautiful shot! Short in length and on the hips. Rahul helps it over short fine leg for a boundary.
An appeal for LBW but it was pitching outside leg. On a length and on middle. Rahul looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Length delivery, onto the middle. KL Rahul drives on the front foot towards the fielder at mid-off for a quick single.
Tossed up on middle. Kohli pushes it to long on for a single.
Fuller length, outside off. Virat Kohli plays it towards the cover fielder for no run.
Short, onto the middle. Virat Kohli plays it towards short mid-wicket for no run.
Floated one, outside off. KL Rahul plays it towards cover for a single.
Short of a length, turning in. KL Rahul tickles it towards short fine leg for no run.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Mujeeb Ur Rahman.
Short of a length and on middle. Kohli looks to flick it away but misses and gets hit high on the pads. A decent start by Fazalhaq Farooqi.
Farooqi makes it to swing in, this is on middle, it is nudged to square leg for one.
This is on a length and outside off. Rahul swings and misses.
Wide! This is full and going across, outside off. Rahul leaves it alone.
Kohli is underway as well. Farooqi angles a length ball on middle. Kohli tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
TAP AND RUN! Length and on off. Rahul drops it to mid off for a quick single.
Rahul and India are off the mark! On a length and on the pads. Rahul flicks it past square leg for a couple of runs.

We are all set. The players from both teams walk out to the middle for their respective national anthems. It is Afghanistan's first followed by India's. Done with the pre-match proceedings. It is time for action. The players are out in the middle. KL Rahul and Virat Kohli to open for India. Fazalhaq Farooqi to start with the ball.

Rashid Khan comes for a quick chat. He says whenever the captain wants a wicket he calls him. Informs they played with batsmen mindset last night against Pakistan and that got them wickets. Says they need to forget about that game and focus on this game. Shares it is a chance to play against a big team and against some big players.

Rahul Dravid, the Head Coach of India is up for a chat. He says his role is to support the captain. Adds they are actually the support staff if they put things rightly, it is mostly on the captains to know how to run the game and they are trying to support their call. Shares they need to put things in perspective. Tells they have lost a couple of matches on a pitch where it is hard to defend. The loss doesn't make them a terrible team. Ends by saying it's a positive environment irrespective of the results and the journey continues.

PITCH REPORT - Ravi Shastri is pitchside. He says Afghanistan will play as a unit after a tough night but Afghanistan have two left arm pacers and this pitch will assist them. Shares that it is a better surface to bat later on as well. Afghanistan will look to make early inroads.

KL Rahul, the skipper of India says they wanted to bat first and challenge themselves. Adds that Rohit Sharma is not playing because he wants to take a break, tough conditions and wanted to keep everybody fresh. Informs Karthik, Patel and Chahar comes in. Tells that they had chat before coming into this competition about the World Cup and this tournament is good learning. Says losing is not great but it teaches many things.

Mohammad Nabi, the skipper of Afghanistan says they would like to bowl first. Adds they had a meeting before leaving the ground and had a green tea with few players but that was a tough night for us against Pakistan. Reckons overall in the tournament they played well. Shares they are trying their best to play a good game and take the momentum to the World Cup.

India (Playing XI) - KL Rahul (C), Virat Kohli, Suryakumar Yadav, Rishabh Pant (WK), Deepak Hooda, Dinesh Karthik (In for Rohit Sharma), Axar Patel (In for Yuzvendra Chahal), Deepak Chahar (In for Hardik Pandya), Ravichandran Ashwin, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Arshdeep Singh.

Afghanistan (Unchanged Playing XI) - Hazratullah Zazai, Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Ibrahim Zadran, Karim Janat, Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi (C), Rashid Khan, Azmatullah Omarzai, Fareed Ahmad, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Fazalhaq Farooqi.
TOSS - The first big update is KL Rahul walks out for the toss along with Mohammad Nabi. Afghanistan have won the toss and they will BOWL first!

The defending champions were favourites to lift the cup once again and after defeating Pakistan and Hong Kong in their opening matches, it looked like an easy destination but it was not meant to be. Pakistan came all guns blazing while Sri Lanka demolished their hopes to push them out of the race. India before the start of the Asia Cup were playing two different sides at two different times, if you can remember but here comes an important stage and all of a sudden India are lacking experienced campaigners. Dinesh Karthik was seen as the finisher but he is not able to find a place and Jadeja is ruled out. All said and done, it’s time for both teams to look at the bigger picture and ready themselves for the upcoming World Cup. Expect both to make some changes in this match. Toss and team news in a bit…
